# Gabe / Jeremy
Date: 2026-09-28 | Duration: 28.540000915527344m

## Summary
The team reviewed an experiment framework nearing completion and awaiting rollout approvals, with the existing surface used temporarily during redesign. Drafts would remain editable before starting, while complex post-start changes would require approval. Diff displays are being integrated into the core UI without a modal, and the legend is being made scalable for many rules, although user-attribute display remains pending. The overview needs traffic-flow visualization showing default values, funnel logic, read-only rules, and traffic counts, while detailed traffic information is preferred in diagnostics. Notion preparation will focus on the happy path, with Bryce building the UI and a polished single surface preferred. A rough QA mockup and test button are also planned. Data-source onboarding has approximately 20% completion because setup is tedious; the proposed flow separates initial modal steps from detailed full-page setup, adds upfront terms and region selection, and replaces documentation tab switching with a task list. Validation runs after submission and needs loading-state UI, while inaccurate smart defaults support a blank-slate setup. Major UI flows and onboarding are priorities, with a major app refresh targeted for October.

## Keywords
experiment approvals, UI redesign, diagnostics visualization, data source onboarding, user traffic flow, QA testing flow
